title: Exploring new directions in enhancing the ACTS parameter optimization suite
abstract: arXiv:2608.14714v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Track seeding strongly affects both the quality and computational cost of charged-particle reconstruction, yet its many configuration parameters are commonly tuned through expert intuition and repeated trial and error. ACTS reduces this burden with an Optuna Tree-structured Parzen Estimator auto-tuner, but expensive evaluations, a restricted search space, and a scalarized objective can limit evaluation efficiency, exclude promising configurations, and obscure performance trade-offs.   We investigate whether Bayesian optimization can address these limitations using ACTS with the Open Data Detector (ODD). translated_title: 探索增强ACTS参数优化套件的新方向
translated_abstract: 径迹种子生成强烈影响带电粒子重建的质量与计算成本，然而其众多配置参数通常依靠专家直觉和反复试错来调整。ACTS通过Optuna树结构Parzen估计器（TPE）自动调优器减轻了这一负担，但昂贵的评估、受限的搜索空间以及标量化的优化目标可能会限制评估效率、排除有前景的配置，并掩盖性能之间的权衡。我们基于ACTS与开放数据探测器（ODD），研究贝叶斯优化能否解决这些局限。在相同的搜索范围和共同的100次试验预算下，我们在现有的八参数问题上将期望改进和置信上界与TPE及随机搜索进行了比较，将表现最佳的贝叶斯方法扩展至十五个参数，并应用期望超体积改进来优化效率、假阳性率和重复率等指标。
tldr: 该论文在ACTS径迹种子参数优化中引入多种贝叶斯优化方法（EI、UCB）并与TPE、随机搜索比较，进而扩展到十五参数问题并采用期望超体积改进实现多目标优化，突破了原有标量化目标和受限搜索空间的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper explores Bayesian optimization methods (Expected Improvement, Upper Confidence Bound) for ACTS track seeding parameter tuning, extending beyond TPE to a fifteen-parameter problem and applying Expected Hypervolume Improvement for multi-objective optimization, thereby overcoming limitations of scalarized objectives and restricted search spaces.
